reader.requirement: At --std 85 each argument of FUNCTION PRESENT-VALUE must be of class numeric, i.e. an arithmetic expression (a numeric elementary item, a numeric literal, ZERO, a numeric or integer function, or a combination of them, §1989:A.2.2 type 1 and §1985:VI.6.2.1), including a table(ALL) list; an alphanumeric item or literal, a numeric-edited item, a reference-modified numeric item (class alphanumeric at 1985, §1985:IV.4.3.8.4.4 GR5) or a non-ZERO figurative constant must be refused. The witness covers items, literals and expressions; it does not cover ZERO, table(ALL) over ODO, nested functions or the refusal half.

edition-consulted.switches: sig.IntroducedIn (85) against ctx.Edition.DialectLevel: whether FUNCTION PRESENT-VALUE exists at the edition
ArgPredicate.AppliesAt(edition year) for a position's extra predicates; the PRESENT-VALUE row carries none, so the class screen ('n' = class numeric) is edition-free

reader.edition-search: Grepped IntrinsicBinder.cs for Edition/DialectLevel/ConstructRegistry/since:, IntrinsicArgumentRules.cs for Edition/Year/since:; the Verified row is Uniform('n') with no edition predicate. ScreenIdentifierPlacement (NumericFunctionIdentifierOperand2002) is not reached for a function inside an arithmetic expression.
reader.witnesses-cover: part: the witness exercises items, literals and expressions in both positions; not ZERO, table(ALL) over OCCURS DEPENDING ON, nested numeric functions, or any refusal

probes.printed: COBOL1627 on all five: PIC X item arg-1, "100" literal, PIC Z9.99 numeric-edited item, W-N (1:2) reference-modified numeric item, SPACE (each 'is of class alphanumeric ... requires class numeric')
probes.expected: refused: arguments must be class numeric (§1989:A.2.34.3 AR1); ref-mod of a numeric item is class alphanumeric at 1985 (§1985:IV.4.3.8.4.4 GR5)

probes.printed: PV-ZERO-ALL= 0060.00; PV-NEG-RATE= 0100.00; PV-FN= 0016.00; PV-ODO2= 0030.00 (ZERO arg-1, COMP-3 ODO table(ALL) arg-2 at 3 then 2 elements, negative scaled rate -0.5, nested FUNCTION SQRT)
15-digit amount -999999999999999 -> -0999999999999999.00; 16-digit amount -9999999999999999 -> size error (ON SIZE ERROR fires), receiver 0; same at --std 2023
probes.expected: class-numeric argument accepted (AR1 satisfied); the returned value is 'an approximation' whose characteristics are implementor-defined (§1989:A.2.3)

reader.notes: The class screen is one edition-free table row (Uniform 'n') driven through CheckArgumentClasses, and every refusal and acceptance probe matched the 1985 text. Side observation outside AR1: the native PRESENT-VALUE result is narrowed to binary64 (CobolIntrinsics.Float.cs#PresentValue -> NarrowResult), so a 16-digit amount returns 1E16 and COMPUTE into PIC -9(16).99 takes a size error at 85 and 2023 alike; the returned value is an implementor-characterised approximation (§1989:A.2.3 item 2), so it is not judged a defect of this rule.
